# tenancy.UpdateUnitInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Renames or moves a unit (`core.unit.update`); a move rewrites at most 500 descendants.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `tenancy.UpdateUnitInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `unit` |
| Permission | `core.unit.update` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | no | `none` | New display name. |  |
| `parentUnitId` | no | `none` | Moves the unit inside its project: a unit id, or null for directly under the project. |  |
| `settings` | no | `none` | Regional override changes. |  |
